_comment: Per-county cautions shown in the app. Sourced from data/VERIFICATION.md (Sept 2026). Remove an entry once the CSV row has been confirmed with the paper.

Georgia.Fulton: Fulton's legal organ changed to the South Fulton Neighbor on 1 Jan 2024; this row describes the old Daily Report schedule. Get the Neighbor's day and deadline before relying on it
Georgia.Bibb: Bibb's legal organ changed to The Macon Reporter on 1 Jan 2026; this row describes The Macon Telegraph. The Reporter's Monroe edition runs Wednesday with a Friday-noon deadline
Georgia.Forsyth: Forsyth County News states its public-notice deadline is noon Friday (5 days prior), one day later than this row
Georgia.Cobb: The Marietta Daily Journal publishes a Tuesday-noon deadline for Friday, which is this row's late deadline; the 7-day figure may be a built-in safety margin
Georgia.Muscogee: The Ledger-Enquirer has printed only Wednesday and Sunday since Aug 2024, so a Tuesday publication day is no longer possible
Georgia.Dekalb: The paper's published wording is ambiguous between Wednesday 8 days prior and Thursday 7 days prior; one source says Wednesday 5pm
Georgia.Long: Long and Tattnall are served by the same paper (Journal Sentinel, Reidsville) but are recorded with different publication days
Georgia.Tattnall: Long and Tattnall are served by the same paper (Journal Sentinel, Reidsville) but are recorded with different publication days
Georgia.Clay: Clay, Quitman and Randolph share the Cuthbert Southern Tribune but carry three different schedules
